_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/combat/test_derived_rule_filters.py. t_juggernaut_lord is Graaz, Unstoppable Juggernaut's three lines on a test card: an attacks_if_able and a block_restriction whose affects name Juggernauts, and the set_pt + add_subtype statics that make every other creature you control a 5/3 Juggernaut. t_derived_wall is a printed Wall; t_wall_maker makes every creature its controller controls a Wall by an add_subtype static, so the blockers filter is shown to read derived subtypes too.

cards.name: Test Juggernaut Lord
cards.oracle_text:
Juggernauts you control attack each combat if able.
Juggernauts you control can't be blocked by Walls.
Other creatures you control have base power and toughness 5/3 and are Juggernauts in addition to their other creature types.
